defects.title: Asset Registry Derivative Extension and Stem Inconsistency
defects.impact: Derivative paths occasionally fell back to unoptimized formats or mismatched extensions
defects.rootCause: Missing explicit extension resolution in khaiMinhVisualRegistry.js
defects.resolution: Implemented explicit derivative stem resolver and canonical webp path mapping in khaiMinhVisualRegistry.js

defects.title: Knowledge Atlas Metadata Label Contrast Below WCAG AA 4.5:1
defects.impact: Muted secondary labels on dark glassmorphic cards had insufficient optical contrast
defects.rootCause: Color token hsl(220, 10%, 45%) used on dark container backgrounds
defects.resolution: Upgraded token to high-contrast hsl(220, 15%, 75%) with optical kerning in KnowledgeAtlas.tsx

defects.title: Settings Privacy Access Tab Button Contrast Below 4.5:1
defects.impact: Inactive sub-tab labels failed automated axe-core color contrast checks
defects.rootCause: Unselected tab state used low-luminance text color without sufficient contrast against backdrop
defects.resolution: Updated button styling to use semantically calibrated high-contrast text color in PrivacyAccessCenter.jsx

defects.title: Hero Video Autoplay Transfer on Constrained Mobile Viewports
defects.impact: Mobile clients (390x844) could needlessly fetch 1.25 MB and 518 KB video streams
defects.rootCause: Video element did not gate source on viewport width or prefers-reduced-motion media queries
defects.resolution: Enforced mobile poster-first fallback and responsive media gates; verified 0 video bytes on mobile and reduced-motion
